PRB_Recent.title: Valence band satellite, and temperature-dependent magnetic and spectral study of $α\text{−}\mathrm{Fe}$
PRB_Recent.summary: Author(s): Trishu Verma, Shivani Bhardwaj, and Sudhir K. Pandey We investigate the influence of correlations and plasmonic excitation on the valence band satellite of $α$-Fe, along with magnetic and spectral properties as a function of temperature.
